lines.en: label dormwartwo13:
Our arrival at Tsukioka manor is met with the level of fanfare you’d expect out of the wealthiest family in Kumon-mi — red carpet and all.
lines.zh: 我们抵达 Tsukioka 宅邸时，受到了与 Kumon-mi 首富之家相称的隆重欢迎——红地毯之类的，一应俱全。

lines.en: But before I’m able to set foot on it, a team of guards escorts the girls who were able to come along off the bus and into a newly constructed viewing room so they can watch the contest without actually {i}being{/i} there.
lines.zh: 但在我踩上去之前，一队警卫就把那些能跟来的女孩们从巴士上带去了新建的观赛室，好让她们不必{i}亲临现场{/i}也能观看比赛。

lines.en: I am not so lucky.
lines.zh: 我就没那么走运了。

lines.en: You see, instead of receiving the same red carpet treatment they do, I am blindfolded and thrown over the shoulder of a large man who I’m {i}pretty sure{/i} only speaks French.
lines.zh: 你看，我没有享受到同款的红毯待遇，而是被蒙上眼睛、扛在一个大块头的肩膀上——我{i}相当确定{/i}他只说法语。

lines.en: Either that or he just has no interest in talking to me. But at least I can take solace in the fact that Imani has been kidnapped as well.
lines.zh: 要么就是他压根没兴趣跟我说话。但至少有一点能让我稍感安慰：Imani 也一起被绑来了。

lines.en: Or at least...I {i}would{/i} have been able to take solace in that if it were not for the fact that when I open my eyes, things are worse than I ever expected them to be...
lines.zh: 或者说……要是等我睁开眼睛时，情况没有比我预想的还要糟糕那么多，我{i}本来{/i}是能感到安慰的……

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme1
Meet the sharks- a team of self-made millionaire investors who are also entrepreneurs.
lines.zh: 来认识一下鲨鱼们——一队白手起家的百万富翁投资人，同时也是创业者。

lines.en: : I have not invested in a single thing. Nor do I have anywhere close to a million dollars.
lines.zh: : 我一样东西都没投资过。我也远远没有一百万美元。

lines.en: : Who is that holding the camera? And why was it necessary to blindfold us for this?
lines.zh: : 扛摄像机的是谁？还有，为什么非得把我们蒙上眼睛？

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme2
Tsukasa Tsukioka is a venture capitalist who turned a six million dollar loan into three billion dollars overnight by investing in Bed Bath & Beyond as part of a short squeeze play.
lines.zh: Tsukasa Tsukioka 是一位风险投资人，她借由轧空操作投资 Bed Bath & Beyond，一夜之间把六百万美元的贷款变成了三十亿美元。

lines.en: She has since spent all of that money on a rogue crew of vandals who add new potholes to the streets of Kumon-mi in the middle of the night and she has no intention of ever fixing them.
lines.zh: 之后她把那些钱全都花在了一群无法无天的破坏者身上，让他们半夜去给 Kumon-mi 的街道挖新的坑洞，而且她根本没打算修补。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme3
Tsubasa Tsukioka went from spending her free time reading advanced-level textbooks to organizing a series of for-profit organizations that have led many small businesses into violent bankruptcy.
lines.zh: Tsubasa Tsukioka 从把业余时间花在读高阶教材上，转而组织起一连串营利机构，把许多小企业逼进了惨烈的破产。

lines.en: Her net worth is unable to be disclosed as it would not be able to fit on this screen.
lines.zh: 她的净资产无法披露，因为这块屏幕装不下。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme4
Imani Imai is the daughter of an immigrant family from Croatia who rose to fame after opening up the world’s first nude lemonade stand.
lines.zh: Imani Imai 是来自克罗地亚的移民家庭的女儿，在开了世界上第一家裸体柠檬水摊后一举成名。

lines.en: : That is not a thing that happened.
lines.zh: : 根本没这回事。

lines.en: She also started her own clothing line at just seven years old and is currently working on building the ninth tallest building in the entertainment district of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 她还在年仅七岁时就创立了自己的服装品牌，目前正在 Kumon-mi 娱乐区建造第九高的大楼。

lines.en: : Again, that is not true.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，这不是真的。

lines.en: Additionally, she holds a 40%% stake in Google’s parent company, Alphabet, and sits on not just one board of directors, but nineteen of them across a variety of different sectors.
lines.zh: 此外，她持有 Google 母公司 Alphabet 40%% 的股份，并且不只在一家董事会任职，而是在横跨多个不同领域的十九家董事会里都有席位。

lines.en: : Why is this still going?
lines.zh: : 这怎么还没完？

lines.en: She’s here today with the hope of landing a major deal that will generate enough profit for her to open up a bakery where she will create exclusively bird-shaped cakes.
lines.zh: 她今天来到这里，希望能谈成一笔大生意，赚到足够的钱开一家只做鸟形蛋糕的烘焙坊。

lines.en: : Uhh-
scene sharktankparodydontsueme5
And this is Sensei.
lines.zh: 这位是老师。

lines.en: : Hi.
scene sharktankparodydontsueme6
Together...{i}they{/i} are the sharks.
lines.zh: 合在一起……{i}她们{/i}就是鲨鱼。

lines.en: : On the bright side, at least we know where all of your screen time went.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，至少我们知道你那些屏幕时间都花在哪儿了。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme7
scene sharktankparodydontsueme8
This is Nodoka Nagasawa, a budding entrepreneur from the border of Kumon-mi who is hoping to receive an investment from one of the sharks for her company, NODOKorp.
lines.zh: 这位是 Nodoka Nagasawa，一位来自 Kumon-mi 边界的新锐创业者，她希望自己的公司 NODOKorp 能拿到某位鲨鱼的投资。

lines.en: Nodoka is seeking a $400,000 stake in exchange for 10%% of her company — valuing it at $4,000,000.
lines.zh: Nodoka 希望以公司 10%% 的股份换取 $400,000 的投资——也就是给公司估值 $4,000,000。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme9
: I believe my ideas are worth a bit more than that. But I suppose I will leave it up to our judges to decide.
lines.zh: : 我认为我的点子值的不止这些。不过我想，还是交给各位评委来定夺吧。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme10
: We don’t have to actually pay for this if we decide to go in, do we? Because I’m finna go out right now.
lines.zh: : 就算我们决定入场，也不用真的掏钱吧？因为我现在就打算退出了。

lines.en: : You don’t have to pay at all if you don’t decide to invest. Miss Nagasawa is simply looking for a platform to launch her company off of, and I would recommend only investing if you believe in the cause.
lines.zh: : 如果你不决定投资，一分钱都不用付。Nagasawa 小姐只是在寻找一个能让公司起飞的平台，我建议只有在你认可这件事时才投资。

lines.en: : Not to be a downer, but her {i}cause{/i} looks a little...{i}off{/i} to me.
lines.zh: : 不是我要泼冷水，但她{i}这件事{/i}看着……有点{i}不对劲{/i}。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme11
: Hiya, Sharks. My name is Nodoka Nagasawa...and I am here today with not just a business opportunity, but a chance for you to {i}change lives.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你们好，鲨鱼们。我叫 Nodoka Nagasawa……今天来到这里，带来的不只是一个商业机会，更是一个{i}改变人生{/i}的机会。

lines.en: : Sharks, did you know that over {i}six billion{/i} people in the world enjoy sex? That’s almost all of them.
lines.zh: : 鲨鱼们，你们知道世界上有超过{i}六十亿{/i}人享受性爱吗？那几乎是全部人了。

lines.en: : And if any of you are like me, I’m sure {i}you{/i} enjoy sex as well. But, let’s face it. Who doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 如果你们中有谁和我一样，我敢肯定{i}你们{/i}也享受性爱。不过，老实说吧——谁不喜欢呢？

lines.en: : The thing is, it’s not enough to just have plain old sex anymore.
lines.zh: : 问题是，如今光是那种普普通通的老式性爱已经不够了。

lines.en: : Japan’s reproductive rate is rapidly declining...and no one has been willing to step in and rekindle that flame.
lines.zh: : 日本的生育率正在急速下滑……而始终没有人愿意站出来，重新点燃那团火。

lines.en: : Until today.
lines.zh: : 直到今天。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme12
: Sharks, I am seeking $400,000 in exchange for 10%% of my premiere dildo company, NODOKorp.
lines.zh: : 鲨鱼们，我寻求 $400,000 的投资，换取我旗下首屈一指的假阳具公司 NODOKorp 的 10%% 股份。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme13
: Mother, what is a dildo?
lines.zh: : 妈妈，什么是假阳具？

lines.en: : It’s a toy designed for adults, dear.
lines.zh: : 那是给大人用的玩具，亲爱的。

lines.en: : If I be good, can I have one for Christmas?
lines.zh: : 如果我乖的话，圣诞节可以要一个吗？

lines.en: : Ask Santa, dear. I will not speak about this any more.
lines.zh: : 去问圣诞老人吧，亲爱的。这个话题我不想再谈了。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay. I guess I’ll open up the floor with questions. What exactly is it about NODOKorp that stands out against your competitors?
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。那就由我来提问开场。NODOKorp 相比竞争对手，究竟突出在哪里？

lines.en: : And how is a rubber dick going to make Japan’s reproductive rate go up?
lines.zh: : 还有，一根橡胶鸡巴怎么就能把日本的生育率搞上去？

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme14
: Both excellent questions.
lines.zh: : 两个都是好问题。

lines.en: : You see, before attempting to solve a problem, you need to first understand where that problem comes from.
lines.zh: : 要知道，在试图解决问题之前，你得先弄清楚这个问题从何而来。

lines.en: : Our declining birthrate isn’t due to an issue with infertility. And it’s not due to an issue concerning lack of knowledge either.
lines.zh: : 我们出生率下降并不是因为不孕不育的问题，也不是因为缺乏相关知识的问题。

lines.en: : The problem is that our people don’t {i}want{/i} to have sex. So the obvious course of action would be to {i}make{/i} them want to have sex, correct?
lines.zh: : 问题在于，我们的人不{i}想{/i}做爱。那么显而易见的对策就是{i}让{/i}他们想做爱，对吧？

lines.en: : Uhh...sure. But how do {i}your{/i} products make {i}us{/i} want to bone?
lines.zh: : 呃……算是吧。可{i}你的{/i}产品要怎么让{i}我们{/i}想去干那件事？

lines.en: : By appealing to the one thing that gets {i}everyone{/i} horny-
lines.zh: : 靠抓住那个能让{i}所有人{/i}都发骚的东西——

lines.en: : Multiple women having sex at the same time.
lines.zh: : 多个女人同时做爱。

lines.en: : I’m out. Too sketchy.
lines.zh: : 我退出。太不靠谱了。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme15
: Shame. I haven’t even handed out samples yet.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我连样品都还没发呢。

lines.en: : Forget about the samples, let’s talk numbers. How many units have you sold year to date? And how many do you expect to ship next year?
lines.zh: : 样品先放一边，我们谈谈数字。年初至今你卖了多少件？明年预计出货多少？

lines.en: : Tsukasa, I forbid you to invest in an adult entertainment-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，我不准你投资成人娱乐——

lines.en: : Quiet. I’m talking business right now.
lines.zh: : 安静。我现在在谈生意。

lines.en: : Year to date, NODOKorp has sold and shipped roughly sixteen thousand units, with an estimated fifty-thousand expected to go out next year.
lines.zh: : 年初至今，NODOKorp 已售出并发出约一万六千件，预计明年出货五万件。

lines.en: : Jesus fuck, how?
lines.zh: : 我操，怎么做到的？

lines.en: : That’s over a 300%% increase. Are you going to be able to keep up with that level of demand? Or will aiding production be what my $400,000 goes to?
lines.zh: : 那是超过 300%% 的增长。你能跟上这个需求规模吗？还是说我的 $400,000 就是用来扩大产能的？

lines.en: : That’s precisely what I will be using the money on. With $400,000, NODOKorp will be able to switch to an overseas manufacturer and cut our production costs by roughly 60%%.
lines.zh: : 这笔钱正是要用在这上面。有了 $400,000，NODOKorp 就能转用海外制造商，把生产成本削减约 60%%。

lines.en: : Why can’t you switch now? Do they require a minimum order?
lines.zh: : 为什么现在不转？他们有最低起订量要求吗？

lines.en: : They do. And for each individual design nonetheless.
lines.zh: : 有的。而且每一款设计都有各自的最低起订量。

lines.en: : Thankfully, NODOKorp is on the brink of launching our next product, the {i}quadrildo,{/i} which will revolutionize this industry and has the capability to ship over 200,000 units just three years from now.
lines.zh: : 所幸 NODOKorp 即将推出下一款产品——{i}quadrildo（四头假阳具）{/i}，它将颠覆整个行业，并且有潜力在短短三年后出货超过 20 万件。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme16
: Could you tell us a little more about this- dear God, what is that thing?
lines.zh: : 能再多介绍一下这个吗——我的天，那到底是什么东西？

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme17
: {i}This{/i} is the quadrildo or, as I like to call it, the next step in sex technology.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是 quadrildo，或者按我的说法，性科技的下一步。

lines.en: : It combines two double-sided dildos into one-
lines.zh: : 它把两根双头假阳具合二为一——

lines.en: : Yeah, we can see how it works.
lines.zh: : 行了，我们看得出它怎么用。

lines.en: : Excuse me, but aren’t you out? Either come back in or keep your mouth shut.
lines.zh: : 不好意思，你不是已经退出了吗？要么重新入场，要么闭嘴。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme18
: The fuck is up with kids nowadays?
lines.zh: : 现在的孩子都怎么回事啊？

lines.en: : Nodoka, as excited as I am about the prospect of four women using that thing at the same time, I’m not really sure if it will address the reproduction issue like you said it would.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，虽然一想到有四个女人同时用那玩意儿我也挺兴奋的，但我真不确定它能像你说的那样解决生育问题。

lines.en: : Sensei, are you telling me that watching all of the women in this room indulge in the wonders of the quadrildo {i}wouldn’t{/i} make you want to impregnate one of us?
lines.zh: : 老师，你是想告诉我，看着这屋里所有女人沉浸在 quadrildo 的妙处里，你还{i}不会{/i}想让我们其中一个怀孕吗？

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Combine that with the fact that it’s a product I’d have no personal use for and...I’m sorry to say it, but I’m out.
lines.zh: : 再加上这产品我自己根本用不上……很遗憾，我退出。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme19
: Miss Nagasawa, that is certainly an...interesting product you have there.
lines.zh: : Nagasawa 小姐，你这款产品确实……很有意思。

lines.en: : But unfortunately, I’m already invested in another company in this industry as of last night, which would make this a conflict of interest for me.
lines.zh: : 但遗憾的是，我昨晚已经投资了这个行业里的另一家公司，这会构成利益冲突。

lines.en: : So, for that reason...I am out.
lines.zh: : 因此……我退出。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme20
: I suppose it comes down to this, then.
lines.zh: : 那么，看来就剩下你了。

lines.en: : Do you have any more questions for me, little Miss Tsukioka? Or are you ready to pound your worries away with NODOkorp?
lines.zh: : 你还有什么要问我的吗，Tsukioka 小妹妹？还是说你已经准备好用 NODOKorp 把烦恼统统砸碎了？

lines.en: : That’s not your slogan, is it?
lines.zh: : 那不是你们的 slogan 吧？

lines.en: : It is.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Terrible. That needs to change.
lines.zh: : 烂透了。这个得改。

lines.en: : But...I’m going to make you an offer.
lines.zh: : 不过……我要给你一个报价。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, please.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，拜托。

lines.en: : I’ll give you the $400,000 you’re asking for...
scene sharktankparodydontsueme21
: But I want 40%% of the company.
lines.zh: : 但我要公司 40%% 的股份。

lines.en: : That cuts the valuation of my business to a mere one million dollars. And with a total addressable market of over six billion people, I believe it’s worth a great deal more than that.
lines.zh: : 那样我的公司估值就只剩一百万美元了。而面对超过六十亿人的潜在市场，我认为它值远不止这个数。

lines.en: : As do I. Which is why I’m also willing to make a royalty deal.
lines.zh: : 我也这么认为。所以我愿意再谈一个版税方案。

lines.en: : I can cut my equity down to 20%% so long as I receive royalties on every product sold for the next five years at $5 a unit.
lines.zh: : 我可以把股权降到 20%%，条件是未来五年内每卖出一件产品，我抽 $5 的版税。

lines.en: : That way, if you {i}do{/i} hit your projected goal of 50,000 units next year, I’ll already be close to recouping my initial investment...while you’ll be ramping up production.
lines.zh: : 这样一来，如果你明年{i}真{/i}能达到五万件的预期目标，我差不多就能收回初始投资了……而你这边也能同步扩大产能。

lines.en: : That still seems a bit too steep when you factor in the additional royalties you’ll be receiving for the subsequent four years.
lines.zh: : 可要是算上之后四年你还能继续拿的版税，这条件还是有点太苛刻了。

lines.en: : It does, but you need me more than I need you. So my offer is firm and you can take it or leave it.
lines.zh: : 确实。但你需要我多于我需要你。所以我的报价是死的，接不接受随你。

lines.en: : Would you perhaps be willing to shorten that royalty deal to-
lines.zh: : 那你愿不愿意把版税期限缩短到——

lines.en: : I’m out.
lines.zh: : 我退出。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme22
: Very well.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : Thank you all for your time...and for your continued interest in NODOKorp.
lines.zh: : 感谢各位抽出时间……也感谢你们对 NODOKorp 一直以来的兴趣。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme23
Meet Yumi Yamaguchi — a struggling entrepreneur with an extensive background in business management and customer relations.
lines.zh: 来认识一下 Yumi Yamaguchi——一位苦苦挣扎的创业者，在商业管理和客户关系方面经验丰富。

lines.en: : Who the fuck are you? Get that fucking camera out my face.
lines.zh: : 你他妈是谁？把你那该死的摄像机从我脸上挪开。

lines.en: Yumi Yamaguchi is looking for $100,000 in exchange for a 51%% controlling stake in her social networking company, Study Buddy.
lines.zh: Yumi Yamaguchi 希望以自己社交网络公司 Study Buddy 51%% 的控股权，换取 $100,000 的投资。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme24
: Yo! I told you to get that fucking camera out of my face, asshole!
lines.zh: : 喂！我说了把你那该死的摄像机从我脸上挪开，混蛋！

lines.en: Starting at a very young age, Yumi faced a great deal of opposition in terms of-
lines.zh: 从很小的时候起，Yumi 就在诸多方面遭遇了大量阻力——

lines.en: : That’s it! You’re dead!
lines.zh: : 够了！你死定了！

lines.en: scene techdif
scene sharktankparodydontsueme25
: Uhh...hi.
: Anybody have any idea how much that camera I just broke costs? Because I think I’ve gotta add the price of that to the money I need from you guys.
lines.zh: : 有人知道我刚砸掉的那台摄像机多少钱吗？因为我觉得我得把这笔钱加到我要跟你们要的数上。

lines.en: : Oh my...I believe it was somewhere in the realm of seven thousand dollars.
lines.zh: : 天哪……我记得大概在七千美元左右。

lines.en: : Then hi. I’m Yumi Yamaguchi and I’m here today looking for $107,000 in exchange for 51%% of my company, Study Buddy.
lines.zh: : 那好，嗨。我是 Yumi Yamaguchi，今天来这里寻求 $107,000 的投资，换取我公司 Study Buddy 的 51%% 股份。

lines.en: : I’m sure that at least two of you are surprised to see me given uhh...recent circumstances and shit. But Nodoka is a fucking cunt and I want to beat her, so that’s why I’m here today.
lines.zh: : 考虑到，呃……最近发生的那些破事，我敢说你们里至少有两个人看到我会很意外。但 Nodoka 是个臭婊子，我想赢她，这就是我今天来这儿的原因。

lines.en: : Luckily for you, I can’t imagine that will be very hard!
lines.zh: : 算你走运，我觉得这应该不难！

lines.en: : Tell us a bit about your company, dear. What is it that “Study Buddy” does?
lines.zh: : 跟我们说说你的公司吧，亲爱的。这个「Study Buddy」到底是做什么的？

lines.en: : Let me start by saying I had no idea I was supposed to make a logo or give out samples or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我先声明，我根本不知道还要做个 logo、发点样品之类的。

lines.en: : Talk about unprepared.
lines.zh: : 真是毫无准备。

lines.en: : Fuck off, brat.
lines.zh: : 滚一边去，小屁孩。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme26
: So, uhh...right. Sales pitch. Let’s see here...
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……好。推销环节。让我想想……

lines.en: : S...Sharks, how many times has this happened to you?
lines.zh: : 鲨……鲨鱼们，你们遇到过多少次这种情况？

lines.en: : You’re sitting in your room...all alone and shit. And you’re a fucking idiot, so you’re just...kind of existing and being worthless and crap.
lines.zh: : 你一个人坐在房间里……孤零零的什么的。而你又是个蠢货，所以你只是……勉强活着，毫无价值，诸如此类。

lines.en: : Finally, a product I can relate to.
lines.zh: : 总算有个我能产生共鸣的产品了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure you could have figured out a way to relate to the four-sided dildo as well.
lines.zh: : 我敢说那个四头假阳具你也能想办法共鸣一下。

lines.en: : Well...Study Buddy aims to solve that problem by...giving even the most worthless of people a reason to both exist {i}and{/i} make money.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Study Buddy 就是要解决这个问题——哪怕是最没用的人，也能得到一个活下去{i}并且{/i}赚钱的理由。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme27
: It’s no secret that dating apps and shit like that have become the way of the future.
lines.zh: : 交友软件之类的东西已经成为未来的趋势，这已经不是什么秘密了。

lines.en: : And in a society that’s moving closer to no one ever having to leave their house again, an app needs to be at the...fuck, what was the word again?
lines.zh: : 在这个越来越不需要任何人出门的社会里，一款应用必须站在……操，那个词是什么来着？

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. The {i}forefront{/i} of innovation in regard to its...respective sector?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。站在其……所属领域创新的{i}最前沿{/i}？

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme28
: Study Buddy...uhh...aims to connect students of all ages with both tutors and friends and...babysitters or...whatever else a customer needs.
lines.zh: : Study Buddy……呃……旨在把各个年龄段的学生与家教、朋友，还有……保姆，或者……客户需要的任何东西连接起来。

lines.en: : Like...I don’t know. Maybe if you want your house cleaned or some shit too? I ain’t really ironed out all the kinks yet.
lines.zh: : 比如……我不知道。也许你家里需要打扫之类的也行？那些细节我还没完全敲定。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme29
: Is Study Buddy partnered with licensed teachers, caretakers, tutors...etcetera? Or is this something that anyone can sign up for at their own leisure?
lines.zh: : Study Buddy 有和持证教师、看护人员、家教等等合作吗？还是说谁都能随随便便注册？

lines.en: : Well, I ain’t sure I’d call it “leisure” since the whole object is to make money from people who need some kind of shit done for them.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可不会把这叫「随随便便」，毕竟整个目的就是从那些需要人帮忙办事的人身上赚钱。

lines.en: : So, that in mind, I guess anybody can sign up if they want. Just like, put your name down and say what you’re willing to do for how much and...hope somebody pays you.
lines.zh: : 这么一想，我想谁想注册都行。就是把名字填上去，写清楚你愿意为多少钱做什么事，然后……盼着有人付钱给你。

lines.en: : What systems are in place to prevent users from utilizing Study Buddy for nefarious purposes like prostitution or drug sales?
lines.zh: : 你们有什么机制来防止用户把 Study Buddy 用于卖淫或贩毒之类的非法用途？

lines.en: : Oh, we tell you not to do that shit in the ToS. And no one has ever broken any rules in any ToS before so we’re good.
lines.zh: : 哦，我们在服务条款里写了不许干这种事。而且从来没有人违反过任何服务条款，所以没问题。

lines.en: : Excellent. I see you’ve done your research.
lines.zh: : 很好。看来你做过功课了。

lines.en: : But why the name “Study Buddy” if the platform is not centered solely around studying?
lines.zh: : 可如果这个平台并非只围绕学习，为什么要叫「Study Buddy」？

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme30
: I figured a name that’s easy to remember and kid-friendly would be best since that’s the target demographic and shit.
lines.zh: : 我觉得一个好记又对孩子友好的名字最好，因为那才是目标人群什么的。

lines.en: : It’s an app to...extort children?
lines.zh: : 这是一款用来……勒索小孩的应用？

lines.en: : It ain’t extortion if they’re gettin’ somethin’ outta the deal, right? And credit card info is needed in order to hire anybody, so it’d be the parent’s money and not the actual kids anyway.
lines.zh: : 只要他们能从这笔交易里得到点什么，那就不算勒索吧？而且雇任何人都需要信用卡信息，所以花的是父母的钱，又不是小孩自己的。

lines.en: : Interesting. But why develop a product like this? What’s the story behind it?
lines.zh: : 有意思。可为什么要开发这样一款产品？背后有什么故事？

lines.en: : Story’s boring. Just wish I had something like this when I was a kid so I wouldn’t have had to teach myself how to read and all that.
lines.zh: : 故事挺无聊的。就是希望我小时候也有这种东西，这样我就不用自己教自己认字什么的了。

lines.en: : If I could’ve just swiped my dad’s card and hired somebody to come hang out with me or teach me words and shit, I probably would have wound up a little less shitty.
lines.zh: : 如果我当时能刷我爸的卡，雇个人来陪我、教我认字什么的，我大概就不会变成现在这么烂了。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme31
: That’s a nice story and all, but the fact that you’re willing to give up 51%% of your company in exchange for just $100,000 tells me you might not {i}believe{/i} in the product.
lines.zh: : 故事很动人，不过你愿意只用 $100,000 就让出公司 51%% 的股份，这说明你可能并不{i}相信{/i}自己的产品。

lines.en: : Why are you suddenly so into this?
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然对这事这么上心？

lines.en: : When in Rome, bruh.
lines.zh: : 入乡随俗嘛，兄弟。

lines.en: : Oh, I had a response to this. Uhh...
lines.zh: : 哦，这个我本来有话要说的。呃……

lines.en: : Right! Yeah. So, what I’m selling ain’t really a business yet. It’s an {i}idea.{/i} Which is why I’m willing to give up a controlling share of it.
lines.zh: : 对！没错。我要卖的其实还算不上一门生意，{i}只是一个点子{/i}。所以我才愿意让出控股权。

lines.en: : Past experiences have shown me that I don’t know the first thing when it comes to running a business. So I’m probably more suited to just, like...coming up with shit, you know?
lines.zh: : 以往的经验告诉我，论经营公司我是一窍不通。所以我大概更适合，怎么说呢……负责出点子，你懂吧？

lines.en: : If I can focus on, uhh...more ideas or whatever, I can see this thing maybe kind of possibly working or something.
lines.zh: : 如果我能专心……呃……想更多点子什么的，我觉得这东西说不定大概有可能成。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Yumi...I’m not interested in investing in a product that will “maybe kind of possibly work or something.” So, for that reason...I am out.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，Yumi……我对「说不定大概有可能成」的产品没兴趣。因此……我退出。

lines.en: : Cool, you ain’t got the money anyway.
lines.zh: : 行吧，反正你也没那个钱。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme32
: Let’s talk a little about monetization as you’ve made it clear you have no sales yet.
lines.zh: : 既然你已经说清楚目前还没有任何销量，我们就来谈谈盈利模式吧。

lines.en: : In this vision of yours, where Study Buddy is used as a platform for freelance workers, how do you generate revenue?
lines.zh: : 在你构想中，Study Buddy 是自由职业者的平台，那你们靠什么赚钱？

lines.en: : I figured we’d just take a cut or something. I ain’t really good when it comes to numbers.
lines.zh: : 我想我们就抽个成什么的。数字方面我实在不行。

lines.en: : We could probably charge some sort of subscription fee too and-
lines.zh: : 大概也可以收点订阅费什么的，然后——

lines.en: : I’m going to make you an offer, but you have to say yes right now.
lines.zh: : 我要给你一个报价，但你必须现在就答应。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme33
: Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa？

lines.en: : Wait, right now? But I haven’t even heard the offer yet.
lines.zh: : 等等，现在？可我连报价都还没听到呢。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme34
: Miss...Yamaguchi, was it?
lines.zh: : 那位……Yamaguchi 小姐，对吧？

lines.en: : You were calling me Yumi literally all day yesterday.
lines.zh: : 昨天你可是叫了我一整天的 Yumi。

lines.en: : I think this app of yours is a great idea...and one that I can see myself using as I also find myself getting lonely at times.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你这个应用是个很棒的点子……而且我自己也会用，因为我偶尔也会感到孤独。

lines.en: : But it’s evident that all of the actual {i}work{/i} still needs to be done as, according to my notes, all you have come up with is an idea and a name.
lines.zh: : 但显然所有实际的{i}工作{/i}都还没做——根据我的记录，你目前拿出来的只是一个点子和一个名字。

lines.en: : Which is fine...as all of the major conglomerates out there were once {i}just{/i} ideas as well.
lines.zh: : 这没关系……因为外面那些大企业集团，最初也{i}不过{/i}是个点子。

lines.en: : The issue is, no {i}idea{/i} is worth the amount of money you’re asking for.  And developing this app alone will take much more than that.
lines.zh: : 问题在于，再好的{i}点子{/i}也不值你要的那个数。光是把这个应用开发出来，就要花比这多得多的钱。

lines.en: : Still haven’t heard the offer.
lines.zh: : 我还是没听到报价。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme35
: I’ll give $10,000 for 100%% of your {i}idea,{/i} which can hardly be called a company.
lines.zh: : 我出 $10,000 买下你这个{i}点子{/i}的 100%%——它连公司都算不上。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, that’s nearly your whole allowance.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，那几乎是你全部的零花钱了。

lines.en: : And, to be honest, that’s an extremely generous offer as I could just {i}take{/i} your idea since there’s nothing proprietary about it.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这已经是非常慷慨的报价了——毕竟你这个点子没有任何专有技术，我完全可以{i}白拿{/i}。

lines.en: : I, too, would like to make you-
lines.zh: : 我也想给你一个——

lines.en: : Don’t listen to her. If you listen to her offer, I’m out.
lines.zh: : 别听她的。你要是听她的报价，我就退出。

lines.en: : I am your {i}mother.{/i} I reserve the right to-
lines.zh: : 我是你{i}母亲{/i}。我有权——

lines.en: : You’ve got a deal!
lines.zh: : 成交！

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme36
: Yay!
: Oh, gosh darn it. I would have given her what she asked for.
lines.zh: : 哦，该死。我本来是要给她那个数的。

lines.en: scene black
scene sharktankparodydontsueme37
: An excellent presentation for your first time, Miss Yamaguchi. I take it a certain...pre-existing business partner of mine was involved in its creation as well?
lines.zh: : 第一次上台就有这么精彩的表现，Yamaguchi 小姐。我猜某位……我既有的商业伙伴也参与了这次的构思？

lines.en: : Yup. Chinami and I stayed up late last night going over all of the details. Pleasure doing business with you, brat.
lines.zh: : 没错。Chinami 和我昨晚熬夜把所有细节都过了一遍。合作愉快，小鬼。

lines.en: : Likewise. I’ll have my people reach out to your people and wire the money over by the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。我会让我的人联系你的人，今天之内把钱汇过去。

lines.en: : Uhh...but what if I ain’t got “people?”
lines.zh: : 呃……可要是我没有「人」呢？

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme38
: Mother! Can I have an advance on next week’s allowance?
lines.zh: : 母亲！我能预支下周的零花钱吗？

lines.en: : That depends. Can I have 10%% of Study Buddy?
lines.zh: : 那得看情况。能给我 Study Buddy 的 10%% 吗？

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme39
: Can you wait until next week?
lines.zh: : 你能等到下周吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. One more week of bein’ poor ain’t nothing to me.
lines.zh: : 行啊。再穷一个星期对我来说不算什么。

lines.en: : Nevermind, Mother! Your assistance is no longer needed!
lines.zh: : 不用了，母亲！不需要您帮忙了！

lines.en: : Darn it again!
lines.zh: : 又该死！

lines.en: scene black
scene sharktankparodydontsueme40
: Congrats, Yumi. I haven’t seen that much money at once since the last time I robbed a bank.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Yumi。自打上次抢银行之后，我就没一次性见过这么多钱。

lines.en: : Yeah. That was a surprisingly...{i}good(?){/i} presentation.
lines.zh: : 是啊。那场演示意外地……{i}不错（？）{/i}。

lines.en: : Thanks...
lines.zh: : 谢了……

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme41
: I don’t think she wants to talk to us.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她不想跟我们说话。

lines.en: : Maybe...let me handle this, Imani. You can go back to organizing assorted Dorm Wars things.
lines.zh: : 也许吧……交给我来处理，Imani。你回去忙宿舍大战那些杂事吧。

lines.en: : Roger. And remember, if shit hits the fan, make sure your thumbs aren’t tucked into your fists when you have to punch. Got it?
lines.zh: : 收到。还有记住，万一事情闹大了要动手，出拳的时候别把大拇指攥在拳头里。明白吗？

lines.en: : Got it...
lines.zh: : 明白了……

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme42
Imani walks away and-
lines.zh: Imani 走开了，然后——

lines.en: : Didn’t realize you were gonna be here.
lines.zh: : 没料到你也会在这儿。

lines.en: And things go back to normal.
lines.zh: 一切又回到了常态。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t really make sense for me {i}not{/i} to be here when I’m the prize.
lines.zh: : 我可是奖品，我要是{i}不在场{/i}反倒说不通吧。

lines.en: : I’m glad you were able to show up, though. I’ll admit that I didn’t think you were-
lines.zh: : 不过你能来，我很高兴。我承认我没想到你会——

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme43
: I ain’t ready to talk to you yet.
lines.zh: : 我还没准备好跟你说话。

lines.en: : And, honestly, not sure when I {i}will{/i} be.
lines.zh: : 说实话，也不知道什么时候{i}才能{/i}准备好。

lines.en: : Out of all of the horrible shit you’ve done to me...that was a new low. A low I didn’t think that even someone like {i}you{/i} would ever touch.
lines.zh: : 在你对我做过的所有恶心事里……那是新的下限。一个我原以为连{i}你{/i}这种人都不会触碰的下限。

lines.en: : So, yeah. I came to your stupid, little contest. But I did it for {i}me.{/i} And it would be really fucking cool if we could go back to ignoring each other now.
lines.zh: : 所以，没错。我来了你那场愚蠢的小比赛。但我是为{i}自己{/i}来的。现在我们要是能回到互不理睬的状态，那就他妈的再好不过了。

lines.en: : Finally have a little peace for the first time in my fucking life and-
lines.zh: : 我这辈子头一回终于有了一点安宁，然后——

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme44
: Yumi! You did it! Oh my God! What are you going to do with all of that money?!
lines.zh: : Yumi！你做到了！天哪！你打算拿那么多钱做什么？！

lines.en: : Well, the first step is converting it to yen. After that, no fucking clue.
lines.zh: : 嗯，第一步是换成日元。之后嘛，完全没头绪。

lines.en: : I’m so happy for you! I knew you could do it! And I’m so glad I didn’t have to since I, like...totally would have dropped the ball!
lines.zh: : 我太为你高兴了！我就知道你行！而且我很庆幸不用我上，因为我……绝对会把事情搞砸的！

lines.en: : Guess I ain’t totally worthless after all, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来我也不是彻底一无是处，哈？

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme45
: Congratulations, Yumi. You did an excellent job and should be proud of yourself.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Yumi。你表现得非常出色，应该为自己感到骄傲。

lines.en: : I must know, though...do you plan on listing your services on the finalized Study Buddy app? Because I’d be more than willing to hire you for all sorts of-
lines.zh: : 不过我必须知道……你打算在成品版 Study Buddy 上挂出你的服务吗？因为我非常乐意雇你做各种各样的——

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme46
: Oh, okay. See you later then.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那回头见。

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme47
: Hah...just leave her alone, Nodoka. It’s clear she doesn’t want anything to do with you and you’re just going to make things worse for yourself.
lines.zh: : 哈……你别缠着她了，Nodoka。明摆着她不想跟你有任何瓜葛，你这样只会让自己更下不来台。

lines.en: : What? I was simply hoping to hire someone to teach me self defense for the next time I am beaten within inches of my life.
lines.zh: : 什么？我只是想雇个人教我防身术，好应对下次被人打得半死的情况。

lines.en: : Not right now, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 现在不行，Nodoka。

lines.en: : When would be a better time? Children and Yakuza aren’t the only ones who get lonely, you know?
lines.zh: : 那什么时候比较合适？会寂寞的可不只是小孩和黑帮，你知道吧？

lines.en: scene sharktankparodydontsueme48
: He said beat it.
lines.zh: : 他说让你滚。

lines.en: : Right now? But that would risk soiling my kimono.
lines.zh: : 现在吗？可那样可能会弄脏我的和服。

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : Fine, fine. I’ll leave you two alone.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我不打扰你们俩了。
